content: Niɡ̶ijo jotigide Aneotedoɡ̶oji eliodi me notaɡ̶aneɡ̶etedi ɡ̶odoiigi, codaa owidi anigotediogi me notaɡ̶aneɡ̶etediniwace jotigide ɡ̶odaamipi. Imonyatediogi niɡ̶ijo anoyeloɡ̶oditedibece Aneotedoɡ̶oji lowooko moditece ane yemaa.

Pida natigide, niɡ̶inoa owidijedi nokododi, Aneotedoɡ̶oji ibake Lionigi me yeloɡ̶odi niɡ̶ica ane yemaa. Aneotedoɡ̶oji ibake Lionigi meote inoatawece aninoa ditibigimedi, codaa aninoa digoina iiɡ̶o, odaa ja iolatedice Lionigi me yajigoteta inoatawece mepoka nepiliditeda.

Lionigi datale digo mijoataɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji me datale, codaa liciagi Aneotedoɡ̶oji. Ibake lotaɡ̶a loniciweɡ̶enaɡ̶a me doweditedeloco codaa me ika midioka limedi minoa inoatawece niɡ̶inoa ane jinataɡ̶a. Niɡ̶idiaaɡ̶idi neɡ̶eote nimaweneɡ̶egi me napitaɡ̶adi inoatawece ɡ̶obeyaceɡ̶eco, odaa ja nicotedini digoida ditibigimedi nimedi ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi liwai libaaɡ̶adi Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane iiɡ̶e inoatawece.

Odaa jeɡ̶eote me daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi naɡ̶axatedeloco aanjotedi, digo anee Liboonaɡ̶adi ane yajigote Aneotedoɡ̶oji me daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi, aɡ̶ica liciagi. Aneotedoɡ̶oji yajigote Liboonaɡ̶adi me “Lionigi”.
Lotaɡ̶anaɡ̶axi Aneotedoɡ̶oji ikee Lionigi Aneotedoɡ̶oji me daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi caticedi aanjotedi
Lionigi daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi, igaataɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji aɡ̶ica otiɡ̶idatece daɡ̶a eeteta okanicodaaɡ̶icata aanjo niɡ̶ijoa lotaɡ̶a aneeteta Lionigi, niɡ̶ijo meeteta,

content.text: amina noko ja jaote me Ee Ǥadiodi.”

content: Niɡ̶ina Aneotedoɡ̶oji me nadeegite Lionigi ane daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o, eledi mee,
Niɡ̶ijo Aneotedoɡ̶oji me yalaɡ̶ate aanjotedi, mee,

content.text: codaa niɡ̶idiwa iniaanjotedi ane iotaka dinoe

content: Pida niɡ̶ina Aneotedoɡ̶oji naɡ̶aɡ̶a yalaɡ̶ate Lionigi, mee,

content.text: awii ɡ̶animaweneɡ̶egi ane iɡ̶enaɡ̶a me iiɡ̶enatakani.
codaa me ɡ̶adiweniɡ̶ideni caticedi niɡ̶ijoa ɡ̶adokaaɡ̶etedipi,
codaa jiɡ̶idaa me jao meliodi me aniniitibeci.”

content: Aneotedoɡ̶oji eledi yalaɡ̶ate Lionigi, niɡ̶ijo neɡ̶ee,

content.text: niɡ̶ijo jotigide aniɡ̶icatibige daɡ̶a jinataɡ̶a inoatawece aninoa,
codaa abakeni ɡ̶abaaɡ̶atedi me oeni ditibigimedi.
Odaa ditibigimedi inaa iiɡ̶o icota me ma,
Ditibigimedi inaa iiɡ̶o icota me laxokodi
micataɡ̶a niɡ̶ina me jiikoenaɡ̶a nowoodaɡ̶agi oxiiɡ̶odi.

content: Aneotedoɡ̶oji aɡ̶ica deɡ̶eeteta anigetiɡ̶ijo aanjo ane ligegiteta Lionigi, niɡ̶ijo mee,
Inoatawece aanjotedi niwicidi anodibatema Aneotedoɡ̶oji, ane iiɡ̶e moyaxawa niɡ̶ina oko aneote me newiɡ̶atace.
